summary: The three original findings are resolved within the corrected fingerprint-bound scope. Independent isolated API/migration checks and 19 focused SQLite regressions passed; no supported remaining findings were identified in this bounded recheck.

Executed an isolated connector fixture: preserved exact expected recipe digest, refused content/data/collection observation edits and verified the audit chain.

Inspected migration 5 and runner with unchanged Store/drivers from the original pass: current artifact hash calculation, skip condition for already current bound approvals, actual legacy decision detection, pending hash upgrades, preserved prior history, pending acceptance, workspace lock, revision and transactionally appended before/after audit.

Executed a version-4 SQLite fixture containing accepted and rejected artifacts with missing SHA, a pending upload with a pre-envelope SHA, and a metadata-only item. All three artifacts received current hashes; only the actual accepted/rejected decisions were archived unbound; each artifact could receive renewed acceptance with correctly appended history; metadata-only acceptance stayed refused; audit hashes and migration idempotence held.

Inspected corrected EvidencePage, unchanged queries/SSE dependencies and app review route: row action now opens inspection, dialog renders the fixed viewing object, and both decision handlers submit that same viewing object to evidenceReviewScope. Refetch does not replace the inspected dialog snapshot.

Inspected new server shape-alias and legacy upgrade regressions, existing transactional migration rollback and connector immutability coverage, and the new browser stale-dialog/expiry-history regression plus responsive overflow check.

Independently executed pnpm exec vitest run apps/server/test/evidence-binding.test.ts: one file and all 19 SQLite tests passed, including migration audit failure rollback, scope races, protected changes, connector immutability and edited proposal constraints.
limitations: PostgreSQL execution and multi-instance races were not rerun in this bounded recheck; root owns the full final gate. SQLite checks and source tracing do not establish a PostgreSQL runtime pass.

No full integration suite, deployment, Docker/service mutation, commit or external-provider work was performed. Original independent-review.json and its evidence artifacts were preserved.
